question: 캐릭터 출처를 캐릭터 선택창에 항상 표기해야 하는가?
conclusionKo: 선택창에 출처 전문을 항상 표시할 필요는 없다. 메뉴에서 쉽게 열 수 있는 크레딧 / 라이선스 화면으로 옮기고 배포본에도 고지를 포함하는 구성을 권장한다. Megumi는 취득 기록의 CC BY 4.0 기준으로 필요한 저자·원본·라이선스 링크·변경 고지를 유지한다.

placement.requiredLocation: No reviewed license requires persistent text specifically in the character selector.
placement.recommended: A clearly named Credits / Licenses action reachable from the selector or main menu, containing the complete CharacterNotices.txt notices and usable links. Keep the notices in distributed builds too.
placement.basis: CC BY 4.0 section 3(a)(2) permits a reasonable manner of attribution for the medium and context, including a hyperlink to the required information.

assets.attributionUnderThatLicense: Required when shared. Preserve supplied identification and notices, source link where practicable, license link, and indication of modifications. Do not imply endorsement.
assets.readmeQualification: The included Readme says the creator's credit is optional. The project's actual acquisition record is CC BY 4.0. Rather than treating this general Readme wording as a blanket waiver for every included component, preserve CC BY attribution in a separate credits screen. Credit4 separately identifies the uniform creator.

assets.finding: All three listings currently identify the Standard Unity Asset Store EULA. That EULA does not impose a general on-screen attribution requirement. Section 3.5(iv) of the Terms prohibits removing/obscuring proprietary notices contained in assets; preserve original notices. Embedded use and monetization in an original licensed product are covered by EULA 2.2.1, subject to its restrictions.
assets.localPicoReadme: Assets/Characters/PicoChan/Source/README.md (creator identified, no additional mandatory on-screen credit clause found)

assets.name: Brute
assets.finding: Adobe Help permits royalty-free character and animation use in commercial games. The Mixamo licensing FAQ hosted on Adobe Community expressly says Adobe/Mixamo/Fuse credit is not required. It also prohibits redistributing raw character/animation files as assets.
assets.sourceQualification: The current migrated Community page identifies author TylerG 3D but does not expose an Adobe Employee badge in accessible page text; no claim of independently verified staff identity is made.
